common.searchPlaceholder: Search used items: laptops, bikes, home goods…

condition.newHint: Still sealed, or bought and never used.
condition.like_newHint: Used a few times. Hard to spot any wear.
condition.goodHint: Light scratches from use. Everything works.
condition.fairHint: Visible scratches, worn corners or missing parts. Still works.

sell.leadCreate: One listing, one item. Photograph the actual item and describe its real condition.
sell.leadEdit: Save when you are done. Buyers see the new version right away.
sell.photosHint: Shoot the actual item in good light. If it has scratches or wear, photograph those too. Hiding them means the buyer sends it back.
sell.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Try again or pick a smaller file.
sell.name: Item name
sell.brandHint: Fill this in and people searching by brand will find your listing.
sell.conditionHint: Buyers read this most carefully. Get it right and you get fewer returns.
sell.freeshipHint: You hand it over nearby yourself, no shipping fee.
sell.manyCopiesHint: For example you bought two of the same book. Usually leave this unchecked.
sell.describeHint: Optional, but listings with a description get fewer questions.
sell.describePlaceholder: Bought last year, used for one term. Box and charger included. Small scratch on the bottom left corner.
sell.describeTip: Worth mentioning: how long you used it, what accessories are included, any faults or scratches, why you are selling.
sell.errNoPhoto: Add at least one photo of the item.
sell.errCreate: Could not publish the listing. Please try again.
sell.errUpdate: Could not save your changes. Please try again.
